model_choice: Position encoding TSP with fixed start. Variables x[i,t] for i != start, t in 1..N-1. Size (N-1)^2. For N=25, variables=576, fits backend easily. Constraints are exact assignment constraints guaranteeing a single tour.

positions.meaning: Position index in the tour (0 to N-1)

daan_lat.meaning: Latitude of Daan Station reference point

daan_lon.meaning: Longitude of Daan Station reference point

radius.meaning: Maximum distance from Daan Station to include a station

derived.how: Compute pairwise Euclidean distances from coordinates

prep.notes: Filtered YouBike stations within 500m of Daan MRT Station (25.033, 121.5436) using prep.within_radius. Extracted station IDs (sno), latitudes, and longitudes. Computed pairwise distance matrix using prep.haversine_matrix. All stations included regardless of operational status. Positions assigned sequentially 0 to N-1.
